overview: The Medford Zoning Board of Appeals reviewed and voted on multiple zoning relief requests, including special permits and variances for residential additions, driveways, and cannabis delivery services. The board approved several permits and variances while continuing two companion accessory dwelling unit requests to a future meeting.

items.title: Special Permit for Cannabis Delivery at 114 Mystic Avenue
items.summary: Approved a special permit allowing delivery services for the existing cannabis dispensary.

items.title: Driveway Variance at 39 Ramstead Road
items.summary: Approved a variance to relocate and widen the driveway on the condition that the old driveway and street apron are removed and replaced with green space.

items.title: Attic Expansion and ADU Variance at 1-3 Vassar Street
items.summary: Continued the hearing to August 27, 2026, to allow city legal counsel to review how new state zoning regulations apply to the proposed third-story accessory dwelling unit.

items.title: Attic Expansion and ADU Variance at 12 Wellesley Street
items.summary: Continued this companion accessory dwelling unit request to the August 27, 2026 meeting.

items.title: Rear Addition Special Permit at 39 Roberts Road
items.summary: Approved a special permit to construct a two-story rear addition that extends an existing non-conformity.

items.title: Setback Variances for ADU Addition at 621 Fulton Street
items.summary: Approved a variance reducing the rear yard setback from 15 to 10 feet to construct an attached accessory dwelling unit addition.
